summary: End-to-end testing of Poda backend (16 pytest tests) and frontend (HomePage, OrderPage, SuccessPage, AdminPage). All backend endpoints and frontend critical flows working. Stripe test session is created (live checkout URL), order persisted, admin dashboard shows commande list and stats.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `_finalize_order_if_paid` instantiates StripeCheckout with a dummy webhook_url ('https://example.com/...') for polling — works but could be DRY'd by accepting webhook_url=None or splitting status-fetch from webhook init.
Webhook secret is not configured (relies on emergentintegrations default). For prod, add STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET env var.
Resend email is correctly mocked (logged) when RESEND_API_KEY is empty — confirmed by reading code; not exercised in tests since payment is never completed.
products_catalog.py: prices stored as floats; consider Decimal/int cents for currency safety in future.
No unique index on orders.stripe_session_id — minor; consider adding for idempotency.
FastAPI on_event('shutdown') is deprecated — switch to lifespan handler eventually.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_ orders created in DB via checkout tests (status=initiated, never paid). Not cleaned up since they don't affect counters (only paid orders are counted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_poda_api.py covers products, progress, checkout validation, checkout creation, order status, admin login + protected routes. Stripe test mode emergent works — checkout_url returned is a real Stripe URL. Resend email is MOCKED (logged to backend.out.log) because RESEND_API_KEY is empty. Frontend uses data-testid throughout pages per spec.
